This linux-x64 ffmpeg executable is GPL-3.0-or-later.

rebuild.sh built it on 2026-11-10 from the tarballs in sources/:
FFmpeg n7.0.2, libvpx 1.15.2, and x264 commit b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55.
source.json records the binary hash, the banner configuration, and each tarball hash.
BUILD.txt records the compiler and the fact that no patches were applied.

--enable-gpl and --enable-version3 select GPL-3.0-or-later for this program.
x264 is GPL-2.0-or-later. libvpx is BSD. The FFmpeg COPYING files and x264-COPYING
and libvpx-LICENSE are the upstream texts, copied unchanged.

libx264 and libvpx are static. glibc and libz.so.1 are dynamic system libraries.
The desktop package copies this binary, these texts, rebuild.sh, and the source
tarballs to Resources/bin. The Rust sidecar spawns the executable. It is not linked
into Electron or the design kernel. Spawning it does not decide the license of the
rest of Futureox Design.
